python3 << 'PY'
# FY1981 = Oct 1980 through Sept 1981 (12 months)
# From Table FFO-5: Net budget outlays row
# FY1981 columns: Oct, Nov, Dec (first year group) + Jan through Sept (second year group)

# FY1981 monthly net budget outlays (in millions of dollars):
fy1981_net_outlays = [
    64216,   # Oct 1980
    56838,   # Nov 1980
    76875,   # Dec 1980
    59099,   # Jan 1981
    53969,   # Feb 1981
    54216,   # Mar 1981
    57198,   # Apr 1981
    54608,   # May 1981
    55619,   # Jun 1981
    58486,   # Jul 1981
    53095,   # Aug 1981
    53698,   # Sep 1981
]

print(f"Number of months: {len(fy1981_net_outlays)}")
print(f"Months: Oct80, Nov80, Dec80, Jan81, Feb81, Mar81, Apr81, May81, Jun81, Jul81, Aug81, Sep81")
print(f"Values: {fy1981_net_outlays}")

# Population standard deviation (divide by n, not n-1)
import statistics
pstdev = statistics.pstdev(fy1981_net_outlays)
mean = statistics.mean(fy1981_net_outlays)

print(f"\nMean: {mean}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {pstdev}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(pstdev, 2)}")

# Manual verification
mean_manual = sum(fy1981_net_outlays) / len(fy1981_net_outlays)
variance_manual = sum((x - mean_manual)**2 for x in fy1981_net_outlays) / len(fy1981_net_outlays)
pstdev_manual = variance_manual ** 0.5
print(f"\nManual verification:")
print(f"Mean: {mean_manual}")
print(f"Population Variance: {variance_manual}")
print(f"Population Std Dev (manual): {pstdev_manual}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimals: {round(pstdev_manual, 2)}")
PY
